published_ranges._notes: Vendor: 'Extruder: 250-260°C. (Better layer bonding at higher temperatures)'. 2.85mm 500g SKU listed by authorised reseller HartSmart (SKU CF/2.85mm/PC+PBT/500g). PC+PBT blend has no exact Bambu preset; Bambu PC is closest (not confirmed). Colour 'Black' inferred from CF line; not stated explicitly for this SKU. Earlier entry: Density is the TDS 'Specific Gravity, ASTM D792' value 1.18 (the TDS header wrongly reads 'Polyethylene Terephthalate Glycol Comonomer'). TDS gives no HDT and no fiber loading. Preferred parameters list a 90C bed, below the sheet's own 100-120 bed range. Colour assumed black.
